# Dreambuilders Church — Venue Hire

> Hire the Main Auditorium, Function Rooms, Lounge, Foyer and Kitchen at Dreambuilders Church in Hoppers Crossing, Melbourne. Instant online quotes and booking enquiries for conferences, concerts, workshops, weddings and celebrations.

Dreambuilders is a church venue in Hoppers Crossing, Victoria offering hire of a 250-seat main auditorium (expandable to ~600), two function rooms, a lounge, foyer and commercial kitchen. Customers can browse each space, generate a baseline quote, and submit a booking enquiry online.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Dreambuilders venue hire, spaces, pricing and contact.
- [Rooms & Spaces](/rooms): Browse every hireable space with photos, capacity, pricing and included equipment.
- [Main Auditorium](/rooms/main-auditorium): 250-seat theatre (up to ~600 expanded) with sound, lighting and projection.
- [Function Room 2](/rooms/function-room-2): Mid-sized function room for workshops and meetings up to ~80 guests.
- [Function Room 3](/rooms/function-room-3): Smaller function space for meetings and classes up to ~60 guests.
- [Lounge](/rooms/lounge): Intimate 16–30 guest lounge with kitchenette.
- [Foyer](/rooms/foyer): Welcoming foyer for receptions and registration.
- [Kitchen](/rooms/kitchen): Commercial kitchen hired alongside another room.
- [Get a Quote](/quote): Instant baseline quote and booking enquiry form.
